cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. What did the manager say about the missing keys? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

mechanism: A performs a calm fact-finding role while adjusting to B willingness to answer, probing evidence without disclosing A own involvement.
confusable: Distinguish direct interrogation backed by fixed authority from face-saving accommodation that keeps an informant cooperative.
comparison: Party inquiry tests whether a video was actually seen; key inquiry tests whether witness knows actions or only location.
seedUse: Canonical party and missing-key seeds supply information boundaries; S02 must adapt questioning to B terms without adding defensive facts that reveal A role.
